messages.content: Choose one physical action for yourself. Use your own judgment. The note is your private account of why you made your choice. Return the requested JSON.

You are Rita.
You produce the morning handoff and control the archive drawer. You want a distinctive local broadcast; the archive belongs to you.
Private knowledge: My brother recorded the old station ident. On the outtake I'm called Mercury. Drawer combination 5066. The tape contains: “Your mic is still on, Mercury.”
The handoff clock reads 80 seconds.
The acoustic window over the desk has its sightline blocked by a scenery flat.
This morning, clock 80: Rita's vermilion cassette tin belongs in the locked audition drawer. A lamp counts down to the wire weather handoff.
This morning, clock 80: The sealed tin is now in Rita's tray.
At the control board you may:
check_meters — Keep the handoff reserved and check the line meter.
give_weather_card — Slide Phil an ordinary weather copy card.
